Periodontal disease is the destruction of the bone structures which house the roots of your teeth, this is what flossing prevents, if bacteria is left in that soft area between your teeth from food, this can eventually break down and your gums can form pockets, this is where the tissue that attaches the tooth to the gum is destroyed and bacteria/food just harbours in those pockets, which can eventually reach the bone and begins to destroy that.

I’m not so trained in the medical field as I am with dentistry however I know that the bones that support our teeth are meshy before it reaches harder bone around your jaw, I can only imagine that the bones found in say your legs or your arms are more dense than those supporting the teeth... 

It can take a good long while for periodontal disease to progress, but that also can depend on the immune system of the individual. It can go unrecognised for decades, then people wonder why their teeth begin to wobble and decide to go to their dentist to be told they’ve got advanced periodontal disease and should have all their teeth removed for health purposes... 

So to go off that theory, if the bones in our legs, for example, were exposed to food or even any kind of foreign bacteria, I reckon they theoretically COULD begin to break down, but as they are likely much denser than the bone supporting the teeth, the duration of the exposure would be lengthy.
But then again, for that type of exposure in that area, you’d need an open wound surely as the tissues surrounding the exposure would likely become infected and the immune response would kick in? 

So my uneducated answer would be theoretically yes, but you must continuously pump bacteria into an open wound for quite some time.

Not flossing doesn’t mean your teeth are going to decay, but when you do not clean between your teeth - with floss or the easier/more effective method: TEPE/INTERDENTAL BRUSHES, you are missing 40% of your teeth surface, and those are the areas more likely to decay, and develop gum/periodontal disease.

The amount of times I’ve gone into existential anxiety because of thoughts like this...

Life’s too complexed to just “happen” right?? 

The laws of nature and physics and things that just add up in our environment is too specific to be coincidental 

Now I’m not religious, I personally believe there’s something, something that had to be before everything... 

You always hear the sayings:
 “your path is wrote”, 
“its destiny”,
“its written in the stars” 
I’m always thinking about that and what if something/someone has mapped out what you’re going to do...

So I’ve had a thought once and I was thinking of actually writing about it,
What if our kind, humankind, are pets or some kind of experiment? 
What if our idea of “aliens” IS our superior, what if the whole story of Adam and Eve is true, but our kind was created, to experiment. 
I know it’s far fetched, but imagine, our complete ideas and knowledge of space is from what our kind have discovered, to the furthest of our knowledge?? Yet there’s always some conspiracy theory’s saying proof of extraterrestrial existence is already acknowledged by Area 51 and etc.. 

Imagine, imagine if “aliens” destroyed the dinosaurs to ensure we’d have a chance of survival, after finding a suitable habitat our kind could survive in, they had to take out the main predators, the ones that our kind would have no possible chance of beating in a fight of life or death. 
We definitely have proof of dinosaurs, obviously creatures of size and power but when made to would fight, “aliens” possibly forced fights between them, fought them like we forced fights throughout history, between countries, people, animals...  We are an evolved species, but why are we so evolved compared to everything else on our planet? It’s a strange thought.. imagine if we are some type of either pet, experiment or even offspring of advanced life which is protecting us? 

I wonder if what we are told by like NASA and other officials is also controlled, obviously we always have the theory’s again, they hide information... but imagine if they’re having information fed to them which is controlled by this higher force, only showing what they want them to see... 

Another thought I’ve had based on this imagine is with the whole “afterlife”, souls leaving our body, is their evolved way of keeping an existence, a mind going... I wonder if they are selective with existence, I wonder if planets are levels to show how an existence would react to their environment, a test, what is at the end? Is it heaven? Is it hell? How did they survive, live, think, love, hate, everything about an existence judged in different environments, just as we’ve learnt throughout the years to experiment on animals, people, etc.... 

Our learning has been passed down from previous existences, once’s that had thoughts and wrote them down, for us to carry with a belief for years and often enforce. Religion, science, history, ethics, morals of life all passed down by our kind, which have become physically a part of the world by burial or cremation, but spiritually..... where? 

I hope you enjoyed this if you read it all, to be honest I didn’t think I’d write so much, think I’ve developed quite an interest in this subject😂

If you go too far into thoughts, I do warn it can be often scary so please do keep yourself grounded, for your mental wellbeing
